CE-MRA-001.problem: Researcher HTML and responses must remain bound to exact compiled, manifest, AI preparation draft, preparation receipt and optional candidate-event inputs; source text must preserve code-point coordinates, CRLF and non-BMP characters.
counterexamples: A changed embedded document with an unchanged document hash.
An outside-event original not in the assigned source scope.
Legacy LLM floating point values change numeric lexemes when JavaScript reserializes the whole input.
controls: Canonical input JSON strings are hashed directly, retaining legacy numeric lexemes.
Exact source hashes, coordinates, original dispositions and complete source partition are verified.

CE-MRA-002.problem: Opening an AI preparation task or editing a segment must not manufacture an actual reviewer identity, independence declaration or semantic PASS.
counterexamples: The exported response reuses the AI draft reviewer_id or assessment_id.
A timestamp lacks a timezone.
An untouched screen silently asserts human identity or completed checks.
controls: Initial metadata identity is blank, status PENDING, all declarations false, all segments and coverage UNRESOLVED.
An actual reviewer explicitly enters new identity, protocol and time before an in-progress response can be exported.

CE-MRA-003.problem: A source directory is not a read original; loading excluded source text must use the explicit FHIR file matching the preparation receipt hash and must not prefill reviewed coverage.
counterexamples: An assignment has an excluded source_id but no loaded source text.
An explicit FHIR file differs from the preparation input receipt.
controls: Unloaded sources remain UNRESOLVED in HTML and Python reception.
Verified FHIR import supplies readable source originals while all coverage remains unresolved.

CE-MRA-004.problem: A REVIEW span cannot be accepted as an existing permission and a proposed REVISE cannot pass without recompilation and independent reassessment of the new current partition.
counterexamples: ACCEPT is applied to original REVIEW.
PENDING/FAIL revisions are silently promoted to PASS.
PASS retains unresolved spans or source coverage.
controls: Explicit PENDING/FAIL revisions are recoverable without release.
A fictional already-resolved current partition passes only with all explicit acceptance and declarations.

CE-MRA-005.problem: Resuming or receiving a response must reject wrong assignments, altered hashes, substituted source quotes, duplicate JSON keys and invalid Unicode/nonfinite data.
counterexamples: A response is imported into a different researcher task.
The audit text is edited while retaining its old hash.
Duplicate JSON keys hide altered values.
controls: Browser export is independently verified by Python SemanticAudit validation.
Correctly bound in-progress responses restore without changing their status.

CE-MRA-006.problem: Researcher files contain unmasked originals and must remain in the project private directory, preserve existing task files, avoid network access and render source markup as literal text.
counterexamples: macOS /private/var is mistaken for the project's protected research directory.
A source contains a closing script tag or image event handler.
A new response overwrites its preparation draft or an earlier response.
controls: File CLIs restrict outputs to this project's private tree and exclusively create files/directories.
Self-contained CSP blocks network and all source content uses textContent.

CE-MRA-007.problem: A researcher export/restore workflow must be demonstrated with actual browser interactions and independent Python reception, rather than only testing an implementation-shaped serializer.
counterexamples: A UI appears to export but generates a response rejected by the authoritative Python receiver.
Unloaded original text is silently represented as reviewed coverage.
controls: Fictional Chrome desktop/mobile interactions export a PENDING response, restore it and reject negative controls with zero HTTP requests.

CE-MRA-008.problem: 存储迁移后仍须按实际私有根目录创建输出；普通open/x受umask影响，可能把未遮蔽原文保存为组或其他用户可读。
counterexamples: 把旧逻辑项目路径与新物理存储路径混用
进程umask为000时新建临床JSON为0666
非独占写入覆盖既有任务
controls: 由当前项目private实际路径创建运行目录
保留私有根目录门禁和独占创建
